description: The Montreal May Day article supports about 100 participants and police dispersal but gives no specific demand to a domestic state/policy.

description: The Halifax report supports May 10 strike onset and a June 6 crowd of hundreds, but does not establish a ≥50 public gathering on the May onset date or when the first picket was held.
required_followup: Contemporaneous May 2023 source documenting first public picket date, turnout, state target and continuation/end.

description: English/French generic and window searches included labor/May Day, Montreal, federal strike and Quebec local strike notices; these notices/announcements were not converted to occurrence evidence. LexisNexis-equivalent archival searching was unavailable.
